snippet.title: Chronicles of Childhood // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3692300/Chronicles_of_Childhood/

A story-rich, platform, side-scroller in the coming of age genre. Travel around the Fantasy World of "Chronicles of Childhood", with your slingshot at hand. Fight and avoid imaginative creations, to finish all the levels and discover what does it really mean to grow up.

Developed by
Georgios Gyftopoulos
